notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.15
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who played the demo so far! It has been wonderful to read your feedback in the reviews, the forums and on Discord 😊



This is a small update for the demo. 

Most notably, this patch should fix the demo getting flagged by some antivirus programs by removing the reported files (which are of a plugin which we no longer use).



As a small treat we've added some stylish sunglasses to the level. They're a bit big for baby Henry but they look super cool! ✨



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/e98734594cf022e7690bc9cea0f6551612acd1a4.gif"]



List of changes:

Removed unused plugin which triggered some antivirus

Added fancy sunglasses to the level

Added a hand full of new narrator comments

Excluded settings from being synced over Steam Cloud Save (usually undesirable)

Fixed camera control with mouse on Linux

Fixed level loading screen flickers on Linux

Fixed debug input icons displaying when no controller is connected

Fixed bug where the door to the demo-ending would not appear when loading gamesave

Various other tweaks and bug fixes
